Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. For guard failures title and detail are the exact strings the dashboard toasts.

code.description: Machine-readable code, e.g. SLOT_UNAVAILABLE, OVER_LIMIT, VERSION_CONFLICT

info.description: Dashboard and back-office API. Errors are application/problem+json; money is integer cents; instants are ISO-8601 UTC; business dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the business timezone.
info.title: Oasis Auto Spa API

get.description: Keyset paged by (start, booking order). `q` searches name, vehicle and package, and the phone only with cli.contact.
get.summary: Appointments in a date range (cards), oldest first

post.description: Upserts the customer by phone and the vehicle by plate, validates the slot under a lock (409 SLOT_UNAVAILABLE "Would overbook a bay — override required", SLOT_VIP_HELD, SLOT_CLOSED, SLOT_OUTSIDE_HOURS, SLOT_PAST), plans a bay, snapshots the checklist, creates the invoice and queues the booking SMS. `override.reason` needs sched.override and records an appointment_overrides row. Send `start` or `walkIn: true` (the next slot on the grid).
post.summary: Book an appointment or a walk-in

get.description: Overview, add-ons with the catalog, checklist sections, photo counts with presigned thumbnails (valid 10 minutes), activity, invoice summary, membership and history. Phone and email are masked without cli.contact.

patch.summary: Plan a bay without starting, assign staff, edit notes

delete.description: 409 ADDON_REMOVE_OVERPAID when the invoice would be left overpaid: refund or adjust instead.

put.summary: Add an add-on (price from the catalog; invoice and checklist follow)

post.description: `expectedStatus` is required: a stale screen gets 409 STALE_STATE with `meta.currentStatus`. confirm and arrive need sched.edit or jobs.status; start and complete need jobs.status. A completed job has no next step here: collect payment on the invoice.
post.summary: The next step of the status the screen showed

post.description: `source: geofence` also records the geofence check-in and queues the welcome SMS.
post.summary: booked or confirmed to arrived

post.description: Guards: ALREADY_IN_BAY ("Already in a bay" / "That vehicle is in Bay N"), NOT_TODAY, BAY_UNAVAILABLE, BAY_BUSY. A booked or confirmed job arrives implicitly (both steps are logged).
post.summary: Drag onto a bay: booked, confirmed or arrived jobs of today start cleaning

post.description: Reason required; `notify` texts the client. The invoice is canceled through the payments gateway (a deposit stays on it: canceled_kept). `deposit` records the policy; refunding is a payments command.
post.summary: Cancel a booked or confirmed appointment
Check or clear many tasks (a section, or every task id for "Check all")

put.summary: Check or clear one task (records who and when)

post.summary: cleaning to completed: checks the remaining tasks, queues the ready SMS, frees the bay
booked to confirmed (queues the confirmation SMS)
Mark a no-show (only after the start plus the late grace); cancels the invoice
Re-send the ready-for-pickup SMS

delete.summary: Remove a photo (soft delete; the objects are deleted after commit)

post.summary: Verify the uploaded object (size and type) and mark the photo ready
Add a written issue note with no file

post.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 15 MB. HEIC is rejected (422): the dashboard converts on the device. Upload the file to `upload.url` with `upload.fields`, then call complete.
post.summary: Start a photo upload: a presigned POST with a size policy

post.description: Not gated on payment, as in the design. No message is sent.
post.summary: Release the vehicle (collected) or reopen the pickup (pending)
Mark the bay prepped for an arriving car (not reversible)
canceled or no-show back to booked (the slot is revalidated)

post.description: CANT_MOVE_JOB ("Can’t move this job" / "It’s already in progress or done") for cleaning and completed jobs. `override.reason` needs sched.override.
post.summary: Move to a new start (capacity-checked, may cross days)

post.description: Bay: the request `bayId`, else the planned bay, else the lowest-numbered free active bay. 409 BAY_BUSY ("Bay N is busy" / "Finish {First}’s vehicle first"), BAY_UNAVAILABLE, NO_BAY_FREE.
post.summary: arrived to cleaning in a bay

get.summary: The synchronizer token to send as X-CSRF-Token on unsafe requests

post.summary: Accept an invite: set the email and password, activate the employee and sign in
Sign in with email and password; sets the session cookie
Revoke the current session and clear the cookie
Change the password; every other session is revoked
Request a password-reset link (always 202)
Set a new password with a reset token; revokes every session of the account

get.description: States: available, blocked (would overbook a bay), vip_held (with releasesAt), closed, past, cutoff, outside_window (online only). `customerId` makes VIP holds and windows apply to that client. Add-ons never change the duration.
get.summary: Slot states of a date for a package

patch.description: A bay in maintenance or blocked counts as zero capacity. A bay with a car in it cannot be taken out of service.
patch.summary: Put a bay in or out of service

get.summary: One day: open window, hour rows, and bookings the rows cannot show

get.description: Inclusive business dates, at most 70 days. Closed days include today.
get.summary: Appointment counts and closures per date (week and month grids)

get.description: Every whitespace-separated token must match. Without cli.contact a phone or email token cannot match, so a number typed into the box never reveals who owns it, and the contact fields come back null.
get.summary: Search customers by name, vehicle, plate (and phone or email with cli.contact)

post.description: The phone is normalised to E.164 and is the identity: an existing live customer is returned with `created: false` and only missing details are filled. Contact fields come back null without cli.contact.
post.summary: Find the customer by phone or create one (and the vehicle by plate)

get.description: `q` matches first, last, full name, phone, title and role names, never email. Pay type and rate are null without team.edit; phone and email are masked without cli.contact or team.edit.

post.description: Needs team.roles as well when roles other than Crew or any exception is given. Errors: 422 "First name and mobile number are required." / "Assign at least one role.". The invite link is only echoed (`invite.link`) to a Super Admin when no channel delivered it.
post.summary: Create an employee as invited and send the invite

get.summary: One employee with schedule, exceptions and effective permissions (ETag = version)

put.description: Fields are optional; omitted ones are unchanged. Changing roles or exceptions also needs team.roles; touching a Super Admin, assigning Super or a role carrying set.billing/pay.void needs a Super Admin.

post.summary: Deactivate (revokes their sessions; the last active Super Admin cannot be deactivated)

get.summary: Per-permission { on, src, ov, limit } for one employee

post.summary: Issue a fresh 7-day invite and send it
Send the employee a password-reset link (SMS first, email fallback)
Reactivate; back to invited when they never accepted an invite

get.description: Query `channels` (comma separated: ops, payments, messages, settings, notifications; default all permitted). Resume with the `Last-Event-ID` header (or `lastEventId`). Channels the caller lacks permission for are dropped and listed in `ready.denied`.

get.summary: The signed-in person: roles, effective permissions and limits, preferences, view-as state

post.description: Allowed only when the real person holds the locked Super Admin role, even while viewing as a lesser role (so they can always exit). Authority is then that of the viewed role alone, with no per-person exceptions; audit rows keep the real actor and record the viewed role.
post.summary: Super Admin only: evaluate the app as another role (null clears)

get.summary: Server time in the business timezone
Needs attention: the alerts, in the design order

get.description: KPIs, alerts, bays and arrivals ignore `q` and `window`; the timeline, completed column, Up Next queue and staff columns follow both. `window`: next24 = today + tomorrow, today, tomorrow, week = today through today + 6. Phone numbers are only searched with cli.contact.
get.summary: The Operations board in one call
Roles with the permission catalog, matrix, money limits (cents) and people counts

post.summary: Add a custom role (copies Crew plus sched.edit, limits 25/25/25; default name "Shift Lead", uniquified)

delete.summary: Remove a custom role: strips it from people (anyone left with none becomes Crew) and returns the affected count

patch.summary: Rename or describe a role (not the locked Super Admin role)

put.description: Super Admin only (403 SUPER_ONLY otherwise, in addition to team.roles). Locked roles answer 409 ROLE_LOCKED.
put.summary: Set a money limit of a role: 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000 (dollars) or null for No limit; stored in cents

put.description: Locked roles answer 409 ROLE_LOCKED ("Super Admin always has every permission"). Granting set.billing or pay.void needs a Super Admin. Publishes `rbac.changed` on the settings channel.
put.summary: Grant or revoke one permission on a role

get.summary: Assignable employees (bay staff: Crew role or jobs.status), without the Unassigned pseudo-column
